name: tr_quickley
caption:
IF QUICKLEY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

😴 Snorlax: only eats and sleeps, until it gets serious. The 25th pick
⚡ Jolteon: stores up electricity and fires its fur like missiles. 2nd in Sixth Man of the Year voting
🗡️ Bisharp: deals the finishing blow without changing its expression. Buzzer-beating three, 97-96 over Charlotte
🎯 Alakazam: its brain can outperform a supercomputer. 40 points on 11-of-13, the most efficient 40 ever
🐧 Empoleon: the Emperor Pokémon, swims as fast as a jet boat. 5.8 assists a night through 8 games
🥷 Greninja: appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. Quick by name, 17.4 points a night through 8 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Immanuel Quickley had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF QUICKLEY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Snorlax. All it does is eat and sleep, until it gets serious. Twenty-four players went before him in the draft.
Jolteon. It stores up electricity and fires its fur like missiles. Off the bench, second in Sixth Man of the Year voting.
beats.dlg: IT STORES UP ELECTRICITY.|2ND IN SIXTH MAN VOTING!

beats.vo: Bisharp. It deals the finishing blow without changing its expression. A three at the buzzer to beat Charlotte by one.
beats.dlg: IT LANDS THE FINAL BLOW.|BUZZER THREE, 97-96 WIN!

beats.vo: Alakazam. Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Forty points on eleven of thirteen shooting. The most efficient forty ever.
Empoleon. The Emperor Pokemon. It swims as fast as a jet boat. Five point eight assists a night through eight games.
beats.dlg: THE EMPEROR POKEMON.|5.8 ASSISTS, 8 GAMES IN!

beats.vo: And the ace. Greninja. It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. Quick by name, quick by nature. Seventeen point four a night.
beats.dlg: APPEARS AND VANISHES.|17.4 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Quickley was drafted with the 25th overall pick (#25) in 2020; finished second (2nd) in the voting for the Sixth Man of the Year Award (6MOY) in 2023; January 7, 2026: buzzer-beating three-point shot for a 97-96 victory over the Charlotte Hornets; January 20, 2026: 40 points on 11-of-13 shooting in a 145-127 win over Golden State, described as the most efficient 40-point game in league history
